Plant Families of the World ID App

🌐 Online sheet (for everyone)
Paste the link of your published Google Sheet (File → Share → Publish to web → Entire document → Microsoft Excel (.xlsx), or the sheet as CSV). The app reads it every time it opens with internet and keeps the last copy for offline use.

💡 Your data is stored locally in your browser. Once loaded, the app works offline!

📖 How to Use This App
Use the search filters to find plant families by their characteristics. You can either select from the dropdown menu or type your own keywords. Results only appear when you enter search criteria.

📚 Sources
Data compiled by Goffe Hoving. Main sources: Christenhusz, Fay & Chase (2017) Plants of the World; Thonner's Key to the Families of Flowering Plants; A Field Guide to Tropical Plant Families; field notes.
💡 Tips
  • Use the dropdown menu to see all available options from your data
  • Use the text box to type custom keywords
  • Click the + button to add more search boxes (up to 5 per field)
  • All filters work together — results must match ALL criteria
  • Numbers: stamens, merosity, sepals and petals are digits (type 5); carpels, locules, styles and stigma lobes are words (type three). A number only matches the whole number, so 5 does not find 15 or 50, and four does not find fourteen
  • No stipule note in Growth Form means the family has no stipules
  • Family rows contain all traits of their subfamilies; a trait that only fits one subfamily ends with its name in brackets, e.g. (Faboideae)
  • Click on a family card to see more details
  • Use Clear All to reset all filters
  • Use Show All Families to browse the complete list
